## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 frozen section with clear suggested margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 93%, InSitu 6%, Invasive 1%, Benign 0% [F1] | Strong Normal lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (α=10%, 90% coverage, n=132) | Single-class prediction set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (atypical), 12/12 kept, JPEG-3 [F6] | Reliable despite atypical OOD (AUROC 0.70) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (0.75–0.79); contrast InSitu BACH_0043 (0.69) [F5] | Unanimous neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score (+1.18, -0.59) opposes invasion (20/20) [F2] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Low score (+0.11, -0.45) opposes invasion (19/20) [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score (+0.08, -0.24), unreliable concept (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Descriptive (+0.41, +0.16; 8/20 spot-check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful: top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in-situ lesion missed (InSitu 6%; contrast BACH_0043 is InSitu, 0.69 similarity, differing in duct_confined).
- Severity-3 JPEG frozen-section artifact masks atypia at inferior margin (28% risk; ECE 5%, n=132).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 2**: Highest heatmap risk (47%, 39%); exclude focal invasion or atypia.
2. **Region 3**: Peak duct-confined score (+0.93, risk 19%); compare with InSitu BACH_0043.
3. **Regions 10, 4**: Check peak segments on inferior (28%) and medial (11%) margins.

OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
